7. 
Reason
Relief Should
Be Granted: 
Applicant
believes
the reservoirs
are tight with low
permeability
and it is desirable
to drill the lateral
to the longest
length possible
to enhance
the economics
of the well. 
These
wells will not drain significantly
to north
and south of
the wellbores
and drainage
to the east and west is limited primarily
to the area affected
by
the fracture
stimulation; 
therefore, 
drilling
the multiunit
horizontal
well
at the locations
requested
allows
for production
from
a greater
portion
of reservoir
and the drilling
of a
longer
lateral without
uncompensated
drainage
to the offset sections. 
8. 
Allowable: 
The well
shall
be permitted
to produce
100% of a normal
allowable
for the
common
source of supply named herein. 
9. 
Previous
Orders: Interim
Order No. 721852
is superseded
by this Final
Order. 
10.

ran casing in the horizontal

or lateral of the well to protect
the correlative
rights of offset owners.
